Flux Finance is a decentralized lending and borrowing protocol. Flux Finance is a money market that runs on smart contracts deployed on public blockchains. Flux Finance operates without traditional financial intermediaries.

ShibaSwap is a decentralized exchange. ShibaSwap operates on the Ethereum blockchain. ShibaSwap is part of the Shiba Inu ecosystem.

Cake is the native token of the PancakeSwap decentralized exchange on the BNB Chain. Cake is used within the PancakeSwap ecosystem for governance and utility purposes.

Ren is a cross-chain protocol for transferring assets between blockchains. Ren uses a decentralized network of nodes to custody assets and mint wrapped tokens. Ren operates without a central intermediary.
